name: Delivery to Jes'rimon
summary: Jediga sends you with the Tablet of Jin'yael to Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar. He is waiting for the delivery from Azshara.

sections.title: Jes'rimon's Delivery
sections.body: The tablet reaches Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar from Azshara, sent by Jediga. He says he has been waiting for it and admires Jediga as both a fine woman and a deadly one. The Tablet of Jin'yael is in perfect condition, and Jes'rimon praises you as a good messenger.

faq.answer: Jediga sent the Tablet of Jin'yael from Azshara to Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar.
Jes'rimon is the recipient waiting for Jediga's package in Orgrimmar.
The package is the Tablet of Jin'yael, which Jes'rimon receives in perfect condition.

faq.q: What does Jes'rimon think of Jediga?
faq.answer: Jes'rimon calls Jediga a fine woman and says she is deadly.

attribution: In-game quest text: Delivery to Jes'rimon
